The asphalt is damp and slightly reflective from the cold air. Lane markings are visible, curbs edge the sidewalks, and a few parked cars and street furniture sit along the periphery. Bare trees and traffic signals appear in the distance. The overall atmosphere is muted and wintry, with faint fog-like haze in the cold air complementing the manhole steam plume.

The plume grows larger in frame as the vehicle approaches; the road beyond it remains clearly visible through the translucent vapor. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle maintains speed and drives straight through the steam, which parts and disperses around the car as it passes, revealing the clear road ahead. temporal_caption: At 0:00 the video opens on a driver's-eye view of a damp, gray city street under overcast morning light, buildings lining both sides and the road stretching ahead. By 0:01 a thick white column of steam is seen rising from a manhole cover in the ego lane and drifting across the road, partly transparent so the lane beyond remains visible. From 0:02 to 0:03 the plume grows nearer and larger as the vehicle continues forward at steady cruising speed, showing no sign of braking. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle drives straight through the steam, the vapor parting and swirling around the windshield before dispersing, revealing the clear, unobstructed road ahead as the car cruises onward without stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
